title.narrative: Digital and Financial Transformation Accelerators for African Regions (DiFiTAR)

description.narrative: At the start of the SDG era, Digital Public Infrastructure—especially Inclusive Instant Payment Systems (IIPS)—was not seen as a key driver of development. Today, however, advances in AI and digital ecosystems have shown that DPI and IIPS can significantly accelerate progress across all 17 SDGs and potentially boost Africa’s GDP growth by up to 30%. Despite substantial investments, many countries have yet to translate IIPS expansion into tangible development results. In response, this initiative, aligned with the UNDP Strategic Plan, aims to co-develop a regional framework for IIPS adoption that will guide countries in integrating digital payment systems into national and regional priorities to achieve measurable development outcomes.
